literal_meaning: ছলাকলা বা কৌশলপূর্ণ কাজ (trickery or cunning skill in deception)
figurative_meaning_en: Derogatorily, the ability to cause harm or mischief
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কেরদানি দিয়ে কাউকে বোকা বানানো যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: No one can be fooled by this sleight of hand anymore.
note: The term originates from Persian influences in Bengali, referring to jugglery or street magic, often used pejoratively.
